dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical structural deviations visible along the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium grey dorsal skin tone visible across the majority of the exposed surface area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A localized, high-contrast cluster of dark and light-toned pixels forming a distinct mark on the anterior-left dorsal quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible topological disruption and localized texture changes at the site of the anterior-left dorsal mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, multi-tonal irregular scar or lesion located on the anterior-left dorsal surface.
